Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 t_rec_count number;
BEGIN
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_source_id is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_rec_count
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type = 'APISC'
 and upper(code) = upper(:ctrl_blk_1.s_source_id)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 1);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_rec_count = 0 then
 show_error('8742');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_O
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_o (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS

 v_where varchar2(200);
 v_string varchar2(200);

 procedure add_and(pl_string in out varchar2) is
 begin
 if pl_string is not null then
 pl_string:=pl_string||' and ';
 else
 pl_string:=null;
 end if;
 end;
 
BEGIN
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'busy');
 go_block('LT_DONOR_API_LOG');
 v_where := 'upper(source_id) = upper(:ctrl_blk_1.s_source_id)';
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_data_source_name is not null then
 add_and(v_where);
 v_where := v_where || 'upper(data_source_name) = upper(:ctrl_blk_1.s_data_source_name)';
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is not null and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is not null then
 add_and(v_where);
 v_where := v_where || 'insert_date between ';
 v_where := v_where || ':ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and (:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date + 1)';
 end if;
 --message('Default Where Clause: ' || v_where);
 set_block_property('lt_donor_api_log', default_where, v_where);
 execute_query;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_source_id');
 
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'default'); 
 
END;
